description: Start checking one document (DOCX, PDF, or a file with a PDF rendition) against the facts of one list. Every claim the document makes is found and, when factual, graded against the list's facts (held facts are left out); with `paragraphs`, only the claims in that range. Returns a run id; read the result with lists.verifications.get. A document holds one unfinished verification at a time.

paragraphs.description: Check only these paragraphs, e.g. `82-136` or `14`: the numbers the document prints on its paragraphs, or their positions when it numbers none. Omit to check the whole document.
